name: Hesketh Cycles
description: Bicycle shop and repair workshop with 2 branches in the fictional city of Penwarden.

items.title: Bike service prices
items.content: A basic service costs $55 and a full strip-down $139; most bikes are ready in 2 working days. Price list HC-SVC-3.

items.title: Cycle-to-work scheme
items.content: Hesketh accepts cycle-to-work vouchers up to $2,750 from 6 scheme providers; claims take about 11 days. Leaflet HC-C2W-1.

items.title: Workshop torque settings
items.content: Mechanics set carbon stems to 5.2 Nm and use the red torque wrench, serial TW-8814. Senior mechanic: Ffion Rees. Sheet HC-TQ-52.

items.title: Demo bike sign-out
items.content: Demo e-bikes are signed out for at most 45 minutes against a $300 card hold, logged in book HC-DEMO-19.

items.title: E-bike battery fire incident
items.content: On 2026-07-23 a customer's e-bike battery caught fire in the Penwarden workshop after a faulty charger was used; damage cost $27,400 and the insurer, Calder Mutual, is still investigating. Report HC-FIRE-0723-B.

items.title: Exclusive dealer agreement
items.content: Hesketh will become the only Penwarden dealer for Varo Bikes from 2027-03-01, committing to buy 220 bikes a year at a 31% dealer margin. Agreement HC-VARO-0301-X.
